title: Ops cadence: handoff notes and SLO digest (Nov 24 2026)
body:
Purpose: quick weekly handoff + compact SLO snapshot for the coming on-call week. This is a working doc — add quick notes under your initials (e.g., -DM: ...)

SUMMARY
- Week focus: stabilize embedder pipeline latency, finish KV cache rebalancer rollout, and reduce high-p99 tail for small-model hosted endpoints.
- Incidents: two customer-impact incidents (one transient latency spike; one degraded throughput for internal canary). Both mitigated and currently in follow-up state.
- Immediate ask: please read the KV rebalancer mini-postmortem sections before morning rota; on-call will inherit config toggle controls.

INCIDENT DIGEST (concise)
1) Incident: embedder-latency-spike-2026-11-21
   - Timeline: 11/21 03:12 UTC spike in embedder p95/p99 for ~28m, recovered after autoscaler throttled back and backfill catch-up completed.
   - Impact: ~12% of embedding requests experienced >450ms latency, a small number of batch timeouts surfaced in a few PLG customers. No data loss.
   - Root cause (current hypothesis): a scheduling regression in the new scheduler (rollout v1.9.2) that caused suboptimal GPU packing for micro-batches; correlated with a specific traffic pattern that increased concurrent small requests.
   - Mitigation: rolled back v1.9.2 scheduler patch to v1.9.1 at 03:42; temporary per-route batching disabled for worst-offending customer routes until we validate packer fixes.
   - Follow-ups: Diego to open a scheduler trace PR and add a synthetic traffic test (SRE-4872).

2) Incident: kv-cache-rebalancer-partition-2026-11-23
   - Timeline: 11/23 16:05 UTC — rebalancer attempted aggressive shard movement; some KV partitions became momentarily unreachable leading to degraded throughput for private deployments using local cache (not hosted). Recovery at 16:20 after toggling rebalancer to conservative mode.
   - Impact: internal canaries showed 15-25% throughput drop; a handful of customer jobs retried but succeeded after fallback to remote fetch.
   - Root cause: a race in partition metadata updates when multiple rebalancer workers acted on the same shard range.
   - Mitigation: immediate switch to single-worker mode; temporarily increased rebalancer sleep interval.
   - Follow-ups: Priya to add stronger leader-election and lock (Confluence runbook link in linked_artifacts). Test coverage gap: multi-worker rebalancing test missing.

SLO SNAPSHOT (short)
- Embedding generation latency SLOs: p95 < 150ms (target), p99 < 400ms (target).
  - Current: p95=160ms, p99=420ms (7-day rolling), error budget burn this week: 6.2%
- Text generation availability SLO: 99.95% success (per-route).
  - Current: 99.97% (7-day) — healthy, but a few higher-latency tails on small models.
- KV cache success rate (private): 99.9% target.
  - Current: 99.6% (this week drop due to rebalancer event) — action needed to avoid further budget burn.

METRICS & QUICK CHARTS (paste-friendly text)
- Embedding p95 (7d): 160ms | p99: 420ms | error_budget_remaining: 93.8%
- KV cache hit rate (private clusters avg): 88% -> degraded to 83% during rebalancer window
- On-call alerts (past 7d): 18 total (8 infra, 6 runtime latency, 4 paging noise)

ON-CALL HANDOFF (explicit)
- Primary on-call: Diego Morales (start 2026-11-24 07:00 PST)
- Secondary: Elliot Park
- Pager rotation notes: Diego has pager for infra alerts; Elliot has latency/routing toggles.
- Important runbooks to skim: KV cache rebalancer (linked), Embedder scheduler rollback steps, Autoscaler throttling playbook.
- Escalation contacts: Priya (first escalation, 30m), Aisha (lead SRE, 60m), Eng on-call rotation for serving-runtime team for kernel-level issues.

PLAYBOOK & RUNBOOK UPDATES (work-in-progress)
- Added a new quick-toggle 'rebalancer.safe_mode' config to flip to conservative rebalancing without redeploy. Need doc snippet in runbook (Priya).
- Embedder scheduler: added a short checklist to revert packer changes and enable a synthetic traffic job to validate micro-batch packing.
- Suggestion: add a preflight check on rebalancer that simulates leader election on a dev cluster before acting on prod shards.

ACTION ITEMS (owners + ETA)
- DM: Instrument scheduler packer decisions with request hashes & log sampling (due 2026-11-30).
- PS: Implement leader-election and lock for rebalancer, add multi-worker test (due 2026-12-07).
- AP: Triage alert noise: split alerts by severity and add a suppression rule for known noisy metric (due 2026-11-29).
- AK (me): Draft postmortem skeleton for embedder incident and schedule postmortem meeting (calendar invite) — done-in-progress (due 2026-11-26).

NOTES & OPEN QUESTIONS
- Q: Are there customers still on the older rebalancer config? We should notify them if we plan a forced migration. (Action: PS to produce customer list by 11/25.)
- Q: Do we want automatic rollback on scheduler regressions at a traffic threshold? Pros/cons discussed — needs product/serving input.

TACTICAL REMINDERS
- During on-call, carry the quick toggle runbook link on your phone. Test the toggle in staging once before using in prod.
- If you get a KV partition error, prefer quick conservative mode rather than full pause of rebalancer (we saw fewer retries when conservative mode used).

QUICK LINKS
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/ops/runbooks/kv-cache-partition
- Jira: https://jira.redwood/SRE-4872 (scheduler instrumentation)
- Slack: #sre-oncall (pin: kv-rebalancer-logs)

ANNEX: free-form scratch (notes to self)
- AK: remember to add a short checklist in the morning: call with PS to review rebalancer locks, ensure Diego has toggle perms.
- DM: put a reminder to run the synthetic micro-batch job every morning for 3 runs during the week.
- PS: need to coordinate with product on opting customers into conservative rebalancer by default?

If anything is missing, add a one-line update under your initials and timestamp it.

-- end of note --
